notes: Paced recording: app/demos/credits-dashboard/scenario.mjs calls say(<id>) at each cue; the recorder writes out/credits-dashboard/cues.json with the actual start times and narrate.py places each line there. Build with: node harness/narrated.mjs credits-dashboard

cues.text: Here's how to check your own GitLab Credits usage.
Open your avatar menu, choose Edit profile, then pick GitLab Credits in User settings.
Up top is your total for this billing period, plus your daily average and busiest day.
Use the date range to zoom in, say, to the last seven days, then switch back to this month.
To focus on one product, filter by it. Here, that's just Agentic Chat.
Hover over any day in the chart to see exactly how many credits you used.
Belong to more than one group? Switch groups to see your usage there.
That's it. Check back anytime to keep track of your GitLab Credits.
